title: Medify MA-50 vs. Coway Airmega 400: Which Commercial HEPA Air Purifier Fits Your Office Suite?

metaDescription: Medify MA-50 vs. Coway Airmega 400 compared on H13 HEPA filtration, dual-intake CADR, 4.8 ACH office suite sizing, dBA levels, and janitorial labor.
excerpt: Compare the Medify MA-50 and the Coway Airmega 400 across 4-sided vs. dual-suction H13 HEPA engineering, 4.8 ACH square-footage coverage, acoustic decibels, and filter serviceability. Includes complete office hygiene and floor-mat integration specs.
quickAnswer: When deciding between the Medify MA-50 vs. Coway Airmega 400 for a commercial office suite, choose the Medify MA-50 for medical clinics, patient waiting lobbies, and HR interview suites up to 550 sq ft (at 4.8 ACH) that benefit from 4-sided 360-degree H13 True HEPA intake, an optional shielded UV-C mode, and a tamper-proof control lock. Choose the Coway Airmega 400 for executive boardrooms, law offices, and open bullpens covering 620 to 780 sq ft (at 4.8 ACH, or up to 1,560 sq ft at 2 ACH) where ultra-quiet dual-suction operation (22 to 52 dBA) and washable outer pre-filters streamline nightly janitorial upkeep in buildings paying $0.07 to $0.15 per sq ft.

blocks.text: Medify MA-50 vs. Coway Airmega 400: Two Distinct Commercial IAQ Architectures

Facility managers outfitting a 2,500 to 24,999 sq ft corporate office, dental practice, or accounting firm frequently narrow their standalone air filtration shortlist down to the Medify MA-50 and the Coway Airmega 400. Both units avoid cheap consumer shortcuts by utilizing mechanical True HEPA media paired with activated carbon pellets and CARB zero-ozone compliance. However, they are built around different chassis geometries, acoustic curves, and janitorial pre-filter maintenance routines.

The Medify MA-50 is a vertical 4-sided tower engineered specifically for clinical waiting areas, high-turnover reception lobbies, and mid-size open work bays where 360-degree air draw, medical-grade H13 particle capture down to 0.1 microns, and a panel lockout switch prevent visitors from altering fan settings. The Coway Airmega 400 uses a wider, lower-RPM dual-suction box architecture that draws air simultaneously through left and right Max2 Green True HEPA + Activated Carbon filter sets, allowing it to move larger air volumes at lower decibel levels during sensitive boardroom meetings.

blocks.text: Airflow & Acoustic Deep Dive: Why Conference Rooms Favor Dual-Suction Blowers

When evaluating the medify ma-50 vs coway airmega 400 for a 14-to-20-person conference room or executive suite, acoustic performance determines whether the unit actually delivers its rated Clean Air Delivery Rate during meetings. Because the Medify MA-50 pulls air through four dense H13 filter walls into a compact vertical chimney, running it on Speed 3 or Speed 4 produces a noticeable 51 to 56 dBA airflow hum. In a vibrant open bullpen, dental clinic hallway, or busy reception lobby, 54 dBA blends seamlessly into background conversation. However, around a quiet boardroom speakerphone, employees often tap the speed button down to Speed 1 or 2—cutting actual ACH in half.

The Coway Airmega 400 distributes its static pressure drop across two large side-mounted filter cassettes feeding a larger-diameter centrifugal impeller. Because the air velocity across each square inch of filter face is lower, the Airmega 400 moves over 350 CFM at a maximum of 52 dBA, and whispers at roughly 38 to 43 dBA on Medium—delivering 3.5 to 4.8 ACH in a 500 sq ft boardroom without interfering with hybrid video calls.

blocks.title: Disable "Smart Auto" Modes in High-Occupancy Medical & Office Waiting Rooms
blocks.text: Laser dust sensors on smart purifiers like the Coway Airmega 400 measure PM2.5 dust and smoke—not respiratory viruses or CO2. If the floor is clean, Auto Mode drops the fan to Low speed even when 12 people are conversing in the room. In shared offices, set both the Medify MA-50 and Coway Airmega 400 to a continuous fixed Medium or High manual fan speed during occupied hours.
Janitorial Filter Maintenance: Integrated H13 Cartridges vs. Separate Washable Pre-Filters

A commercial air purifier's 3-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) depends heavily on how coarse carpet lint and clothing fibers are managed before they reach the pleated HEPA media. On the Medify MA-50, the outer pre-filter fabric is bonded directly onto the 3-in-1 H13 HEPA and carbon cartridge. While that makes filter replacement a completely hands-free, single-step swap every 3,000 operating hours (roughly 4 to 6 months of 24/7 operation, or 9 to 12 months of business-hours operation), coarse dust accumulates directly on the disposable cartridge.

The Coway Airmega 400 separates the permanent micro-mesh pre-filters from the internal Max2 HEPA/Carbon packs. Under a standard 2x/week, 3x/week, or 5x/week janitorial contract, your night crew can pop off the magnetic side grilles in 15 seconds, vacuum the washable mesh pre-filters with a brush attachment, and snap them back into place. Keeping lint off the primary Max2 pleats preserves full CFM airflow for a full 12 months.
Whole-Suite Particulate & VOC Control: Coordinating Mats, Liners, and Low-VOC Soap

Installing a Medify MA-50 or Coway Airmega 400 solves airborne resuspension, but facility managers achieve the highest IAQ and lowest janitorial cost when they simultaneously eliminate dust and synthetic VOCs at their entry, workstation, and restroom sources:

items: Gorilla Grip Commercial Grade 36x60 Heavy-Duty Door Mat: Stationed at suite entrances, its natural rubber backing and deep-groove top surface trap coarse shoe grit before it dries into airborne PM10 carpet dust.
Rubber-Cal Corrugated Ribbed 3x12 Commercial Rubber Runner: Provides a 12-foot non-slip, 1/8-inch thick waterproof rubber runway at wet service doors, breakroom entrances, and delivery corridors.

Wearwell 24/7 Anti-Fatigue Standing Desk & Reception Mat: 3x5-foot, 5/8-inch thick closed-cell nitrile-rubber mat with beveled edges that will not off-gas cheap PVC odors or shed foam dust near reception air purifiers.

PURELL ES8 1200 mL Healthy Soap Foam Refill (2-Pack): Fragrance-free, dye-free green-certified foam hand soap refills that prevent synthetic perfume VOCs from saturating your purifier's activated carbon bed.

Plasticplace 30x36 Clear 20–30 Gallon Recycling Can Liners (250-Case): 0.75-mil clear LLDPE liners allowing nightly crews to audit single-stream recycling bins and prevent rotting food waste from generating indoor odors.

blocks.text: Step-by-Step Commissioning Checklist for Office Air Purifiers

items.name: Unbag All Internal Filter Cartridges Before First Power-On
items.text: Both the Medify MA-50 (four side panels) and the Coway Airmega 400 (two side Max2 packs) ship with their internal H13 HEPA/carbon filters sealed inside protective plastic polybags. Remove all plastic wrapping before plugging the units in.

items.name: Match Unit Architecture to Room Geometry
items.text: Place the 4-sided Medify MA-50 in central waiting areas with at least 18 inches of clearance on all four sides; place the dual-suction Coway Airmega 400 along conference room walls where its front and back faces sit near the wall while its left and right intakes breathe freely.

items.name: Lock in Fixed Daytime Fan Speeds for 4.8 ACH
items.text: Set the Medify MA-50 to Speed 2 or 3 and activate the child/tamper lock in visitor waiting areas; set the Coway Airmega 400 to manual Speed 2 or 3 during meeting hours rather than relying solely on Eco sleep thresholds.

items.name: Add Pre-Filter Vacuuming and Damp Wiping to the Janitorial Checklist
items.text: Have your evening cleaning crew wipe the exterior housing with a slightly damp microfiber cloth and vacuum the Coway washable pre-filters every second week (biweekly, 2.17x/month) during their normal HEPA vacuum rotation.

faqs.q: Should we leave the UV-C light turned on inside the Medify MA-50 in our office waiting room?
faqs.a: The internal UV-C light on the Medify MA-50 is enclosed inside the chassis to irradiate captured microbes on the filter surface without exposing occupants to UV rays, and it can be toggled on or off from the control panel. However, the heavy lifting for office particulate and aerosol removal is performed by the 4-sided H13 True HEPA media (99.9% capture down to 0.1 microns), so running mechanical filtration with or without UV-C delivers full CADR performance.

faqs.q: Why does fragrance-free soap like PURELL ES8 matter when running activated carbon HEPA air purifiers?
faqs.a: Activated carbon pellets inside the Medify MA-50 and Coway Airmega 400 have a finite pore surface area for adsorbing gaseous VOCs. Using heavily perfumed soaps, aerosol air fresheners, or pine-scented floor cleaners quickly saturates the carbon pores with synthetic fragrance molecules. Specifying fragrance-free, dye-free PURELL ES8 foam soap and neutral-pH floor cleaners preserves carbon capacity for real chemical pollutants and wildfire smoke.

faqs.q: How does the Wearwell 24/7 anti-fatigue mat hold up to nightly janitorial disinfecting compared to foam mats?
faqs.a: The Wearwell 24/7 3x5 mat is molded from 5/8-inch closed-cell nitrile-blended rubber with integral beveled edges. Unlike open-cell polyurethane mats that absorb mop water and emit chemical odors, closed-cell nitrile rubber is non-porous, resists quaternary disinfectants under OSHA HazCom protocols, and never sheds dust particles into your reception air purifiers.

faqs.q: Does vacuuming the Coway Airmega 400 pre-filters add extra cost to a commercial janitorial contract?
faqs.a: No. When included in your baseline Scope of Work (SOW), popping open the two magnetic side covers on a Coway Airmega 400 and running a HEPA backpack vacuum brush over the mesh pre-filters takes less than 90 seconds every two weeks (biweekly, 2.17 visits/month). Janitorial contractors readily absorb this task into their standard high-dusting checklist at no surcharge.

faqs.q: How do entrance mats like the Gorilla Grip 36x60 and Rubber-Cal 3x12 reduce office PM2.5 and PM10 levels?
faqs.a: Walk-off mats act as the primary coarse-particulate filter for the entire office suite. By trapping mud, de-icing salts, and tire dust on a Gorilla Grip 36x60 natural-rubber threshold mat or a 12-foot Rubber-Cal Corrugated rubber runner at service doors, you prevent shoes from grinding dry dirt into office carpet where footsteps resuspend it as airborne PM10 and PM2.5.
